lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters arranged in vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. The spots exhibit a higher spatial density near the branchial region, transitioning to larger, more isolated nodes moving posteriorly toward the mid-body.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary circular blobs, creating a grid-like framework of anchor nodes most visible in the transition zone between the gills and the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal linear ridges are visible across the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with high-intensity values on the superior edge and low-intensity values (shadowing) on the inferior edge.
